description: Plan a dated passenger-car trip through Czechia, Austria, Hungary, Slovakia, Slovenia, Romania, Bulgaria, Switzerland and Moldova. Compare verified vignette validity, official links, separately payable tolls and optional VignetteGO quotes.

asymmetric_route_confirmed.description: Set true only when the traveller confirms that the opposite direction deliberately skips a listed country.

crossings.description: Every local calendar day of motorway use, separately by country and direction, including additional days and midnight crossings. No automatic routing from city names.

date.description: Local YYYY-MM-DD of actual road use.

network.description: Use vignette for a vignette-required road (including applicable Romanian national roads); for foreign cars in Moldova it means the declared stay. Section-toll-only is not equivalent to untolled.

segments.description: For AT pass [] only after confirming no separate toll sections on this leg. Supported priced IDs: AT_A9_BOSRUCK, AT_A9_GLEINALM, AT_A10_FLACHAU_RENNWEG, AT_A10_FLACHAU_ST_MICHAEL, AT_A10_FLACHAU_ZEDERHAUS, AT_A10_ST_MICHAEL_RENNWEG, AT_A11_AUSTRIA_TO_SLOVENIA, AT_A13_FULL_BRENNER, AT_S16_ARLBERG. Known vignette-free corridors: AT_A1_WALSERBERG_SALZBURG_NORD, AT_A12_BORDER_KUFSTEIN_SUED, AT_A14_BORDER_HOHENEMS. Unknown identifiers are not silently ignored.

stay_until.description: For a foreign vehicle entering Moldova: actual date of leaving Moldova, inclusive. Provide one stay, not only selected driving days.

currency.description: Commercial quote currency. Official prices stay in the operator’s original currency.

journey_type.description: When omitted infer a return only from supplied return crossings.

language.description: User response and commercial website handoff language. Translate any detailed reference text to this language when presenting it.

purchase_date.description: Earliest planned purchase date, local YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

category.description: Passenger car of at most 3.5 t under each country’s applicable maximum mass rule.

czech_exemption_confirmed.description: For electric/hydrogen only: confirm Czech registration or accepted Czech exemption for a foreign vehicle. No licence plate.

hungary_class.description: Confirmed Hungarian class; D1 is M1/M1G, up to seven seats including driver and ≤3.5 t. D2 is official-only here.

moldova_registration.description: Whether the car is registered in Moldova; do not send the plate.

propulsion.description: For Czechia: standard includes petrol, diesel, LPG, and hybrids not eligible for a discount. Never infer eligibility from hybrid alone.

romania_emissions.description: Confirmed Romanian category-A emissions band. Do not infer it from vehicle age.

slovenia_class.description: DARS class confirmed from its vehicle list. 2B is official-only here.

towing_trailer.description: Set true for a trailer; this tool does not calculate combined-vehicle/trailer entitlements.

name: plan_motorway_vignettes
title: Plan motorway vignettes and separate tolls
